title: SIGIL II
description: Created by John Romero, SIGIL II is a nine-level episode for Doom and sequel to SIGIL. Each level features a secret that closes after 30 seconds, a secret opened by shooting a FIREBLU texture, and at least one cyberdemon on Ultra-Violence. The release triples the spider mastermind's health to 9,000 and includes soundtracks by Thorr and James Paddock.
notes: Imported from an owned GOG release (sigil2.wad). Also available free at [romero.com](https://romero.com/sigil). [DoomWiki](https://doomwiki.org/wiki/SIGIL_II)
